_about: Limits and estimates used by scripts/diagram_check.py. The contrast ratios are WCAG 2.x values written from memory; every other entry is a judgement call or an estimate of renderer behaviour. None was read in a primary source during this work, so every entry is verified: false. Change a value here, not in the script.

large_text_px.source: WCAG 2.2 'large scale' text, 18 pt, from memory

large_bold_text_px.source: WCAG 2.2 'large scale' bold text, 14 pt, from memory

min_font_px.source: judgement: smallest label size that stays readable when a diagram is shown at its own size

char_width_em.source: estimate: average advance of a proportional sans-serif character; used because the script has no font metrics

mono_char_width_em.source: estimate: advance of a common monospace font

ascent_em.source: estimate: share of the font size above the baseline

line_height_em.source: estimate: line height of wrapped labels

overlap_tolerance_px.source: judgement: shared borders and estimate error are not overlaps

edge_gap_px.source: judgement: room for an arrowhead marker between a line end and the shape it points at

label_gap_px.source: judgement: a label this close to a shape, outside any other shape, names it (icon with caption)

min_node_px.source: judgement: shapes smaller than this on both sides are arrowheads, dots or icons, not nodes

node_group_max_shapes.source: judgement: a <g> with this many shapes or fewer is one node drawn from parts (a cylinder, a card with a header)

background_cover.source: judgement: a shape covering this much of the canvas is the diagram's background

page_light.source: judgement: page behind a transparent diagram in a light theme

page_dark.source: judgement: a typical dark page (code hosts and docs sites in dark mode)

page_text_light.source: judgement: text colour that currentColor and theme-default colours take on a light page

page_text_dark.source: judgement: text colour that currentColor and theme-default colours take on a dark page

drawio_font_px.source: draw.io default fontSize when a style sets none, from memory

mermaid_text_light.source: Mermaid default theme node text, from memory

mermaid_text_dark.source: Mermaid dark theme node text, from memory

mermaid_fill_light.source: Mermaid default theme node fill, from memory

mermaid_fill_dark.source: Mermaid dark theme node fill, from memory
